reviews.author: Hunter

reviews.title: Don't do it.
reviews.comment:
Build my water cooled pc before testing it. It won't POST. They do not have a diagnostic light and they removed the speaker header, so if it doesn't work, you'll have absolutely no idea why. The only way to troubleshoot is to remove and replace every component.
The motherboard is listed as supporting the Intel i7-14700kf. However, it shipped with a BIOS version older than the 14th gen. Maybe that's why it doesn't work.
Regardless, I later found out that it has a maximum power draw of 150W for the CPU, meaning any i7 and possibly even i5s will be SEVERELY performance limited. It disgusts me that they list the processor as compatible without mentioning the possibly required BIOS update (of which you need an old processor to do) and the fact that your processor will suck with this motherboard anyway.
Removing diagnostic abilities is pretty inexcusable too. Returning and buying a different brand. Don't cheap out like me.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Good Board, be careful of RAM Slots
reviews.comment:
I love the board, has pretty good I/O and overall the size/price with what you get is pretty good. My biggest complaint is that there is only one port for CPU/WP controls, so I did not get to set up my AIO how I wanted.
Word of caution: I did get a board with a dead RAM slot, but they were kind enough to send me replacement. The new board works perfectly, with no issues. Just something to keep in mind.
reviews.author: LuneyTwister
